name: HSPLANT
recent: Hap Seng Plantations 于2026年11月17日发布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，第三季净利同比下滑7%至约4800万令吉，尽管CPO价格走高。同期公司出现多项董事委员会人事变动，包括Choy Khai Choon辞任董事。此外，公司按月披露鲜果串产量数据。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日季度净利同比下滑7%至约4800万令吉。
Choy Khai Choon 辞任董事，并退出审计、薪酬及提名委员会。
公司按月披露种植园产量数据。
risks: 季度净利同比下滑7%，尽管CPO价格走高。
印尼新土地改革法带来监管不确定性，可能影响在印尼有业务敞口的种植公司。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度营收2.017亿令吉，环比增4.8%，同比增29.2%；净利3932万令吉，环比增294.4%，同比增100.0%；净利率19.5%，高于上季的5.2%。

recent_en: Hap Seng Plantations released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November 2026, with 3Q net profit falling 7% year-on-year to about RM48 million despite higher CPO prices. The company also saw several board committee changes, including the resignation of director Choy Khai Choon. Monthly fresh fruit bunch production figures were disclosed.
notable_en: 3Q net profit for the period ended 30 September 2026 fell 7% year-on-year to about RM48 million.
Choy Khai Choon resigned as director and stepped down from the audit, remuneration and nomination committees.
The company disclosed monthly plantation production figures.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell 7% year-on-year despite higher CPO prices.
Indonesia's new land reform law creates regulatory uncertainty that may affect planters with exposure to Indonesia.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM201.7 million, up 4.8% qoq and 29.2% yoy; net income was RM39.3 million, up 294.4% qoq and 100.0% yoy; net margin was 19.5%, up from 5.2% in the previous quarter.
